headline: Maresca has been pushing all the right buttons in perfect Man City start
description: Despite using an alternative team, Manchester City made it six wins from six under Enzo Maresca, highlighting just how smoothly the post-Pep Guardiola era has begun.

headline: Marco Rose proud of 'Bournemouth football' in European debut win over Real Sociedad
description: Marco Rose was delighted to watch "Bournemouth football" during a 2-1 win at Real Sociedad and a memorable first match in Europe for the Premier League club.

headline: Man City's 17-year-old Floyd Samba: Debut brace vs. Norwich was 'mind-blowing'
description: Teenager Floyd Samba said his debut was "mind-blowing" after his stunning two-goal display in Manchester City's 5-0 thrashing of Norwich.
